messages:
alex_k: quick sync — proposing a formal intake SLA + account-mapping rules for SI co-sell claims (marketplace + HW partners). can we lock this today?

mira_patel: on it. what SLA are you thinking? 24h claim ack, 72h owner assignment?

jonah_s: i'd push for 12h ack for high-priority deals (> $50k ARR). standard could be 24–48h.

alex_k: agree. proposal: ack window = 12h for priority, 24h for standard. owner assignment = 72h max. if unassigned after 72h, auto-escalate to partnerships-oncall and email partnerships@.

sophia_r: how are we marking priority? CRM tag + partner claim form field `estimated_contract_size`?

alex_k: yes. priority = est_contract_size >= 50000 OR explicit intake checkbox `co-sell priority` OR marketplace spotlight (AWS Marketplace / NVIDIA HW partner). we'll update the intake form and docs.

jonah_s: routing logic draft (pseudo):
```
if claim.priority:
  route -> regional_si_queue
elif partner_type == 'HW' and est_size >= 100000:
  route -> hw-partner-lead
else:
  route -> general-intake
```

mira_patel: we should add a 48h de-dup/hold window for duplicate claims — auto-merge if same account within 7d, manual review otherwise.

alex_k: ownership rules: SI owns net-new pipeline they introduced for 90 days post-intake unless customer explicitly requests Redwood to take over. map account->partner in CRM and add `partnerships_map` tag for quick queries.

sophia_r: joint announcements cadence: draft PR for customer quote + partner approvable copy within 2 weeks of signed deal; legal + partner comms sign-off 1 week before publish.

jonah_s: addendum: for HW partners we need a 30-day technical validation checklist before marketplace publish — infra/eng to own the checklist and sign-off.

si_intake_bot: claim #8745 created by @acme_corp and routed to general-intake (est_size: 120000) — flagged priority

alex_k: @si_intake_bot can we auto-route this to hw-partner-lead? est_size > 100k and partner = NVIDIA.

si_intake_bot: routed claim #8745 to @mira_patel and @jonah_s. tags: priority, hw-routing. ETA ack: 11h.

mira_patel: :thumbsup: i'll take point. will update CRM mapping, ping SI partner PMs, and schedule triage 10:00 PT.

sophia_r: i'll create an audit event for the joint announcement pipeline and add a template PR in the marketing repo.

alex_k: action items: mira — update intake form + routing rules; jonah — add pseudo-code to infra repo and CI test; sophia — create announcement template; i'll draft escalation play and partner email. 9:00am PT sync tomorrow?

jonah_s: 9am PT works. also adding automation task: 72h unassigned -> auto-escalate to partnerships-oncall and create an incident ticket.

mira_patel: added to my board. i'll run a mock claim in the morning and share results in the channel.
